summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center thermal-management node. The direct-exposure universe is not limited to obvious AI hardware names: it includes critical digital infrastructure vendors, industrial chiller suppliers, liquid-cooling ecosystems, custom HVAC/platform suppliers, controls, heat rejection, and service capacity.
